snippet.title: 13 BONES - TEASER TRAILER
snippet.description:
13 BONES is a fast-paced card battler. Like BLACKJACK, but with added MONSTERS and VIOLENCE. Build your DECK and push your LUCK (maybe even break some rules) to earn your freedom !
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4417710/13_BONES/?beta=0
